question: Do weight-predicted L15H5/H1 causally mediate a material and concentrated part of the confirmed H3 rank-eight behavioral effect?

authority.rank8_status: Paired confirmation: 91-94% full-H3 behavior, <=8.9% complement, and 96.7-97.0% L15H5/H1 response transport.
authority.original_l15_pair_status: On the original writer response H5/H1 carried 95.32%/92.49% of complete attention-15 behavior; the other seven carried 4.70%/7.53%.

frozen_design.upstream_intervention: Install the exact confirmed H3 rank-eight projection of the live L8H1-induced H3 response at every causal position.
frozen_design.reader_removal: During that same forward, dynamically replace the H3-induced L15 head-output response with its native-base value for: all nine heads, H5/H1, or the other seven. A base H5/H1 self-clamp is the inert tripwire.

predictions.pred_a_authority_exact_composed_instrume: Hashes, rank-eight replay, dynamic clamp closure, self-clamp per-logit identity, reconstruction, finite coverage, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_complete_l15_response_is_material: Clamping all L15 heads removes at least 10% of rank-eight mean behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_h5h1_concentrate_l15_mediation: H5/H1 explain at least 80% of complete-L15 removal in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_other_seven_are_secondary: The other seven explain at most 20% of complete-L15 removal in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_rank8_replays: Unclamped rank-eight behavior matches the confirmation receipt within 1e-6.

decision: All predicates identify a causal H3-rank8 -> L15H5/H1 reader edge. If transport is large but complete-L15 removal is below 10%, classify the pair as a representational reader rather than a behavioral mediator. If complete L15 is material but the pair is not concentrated, reopen the full head set.
